content.text: Kingen (also known as King) is a Belgian and French trick-taking game played by four individuals. It is a 'compendium' game where a full session consists of a series of rounds with different objectivesâ€”some rounds are 'negative' (avoiding specific tricks or cards) while others are 'positive' (trying to win tricks). It is the European parent of the game Barbu.
Dates to the early 20th century in Western Europe. It evolved from simpler 'penalty' games like Hearts into a structured multi-round tournament format favored by university students and social clubs.
Standard 52-card deck. Aces are high, 2s are low.
